column1: # OpenMicroCam — the stock firmware of the YIZHAN 4K camera (SigmaStar SSC8836 / Mercury6, GC8613) as found on the
# tested camera: every file and flash region docs/firmware/blobs.md maps and the boot files the install depends on, with
# their sizes and sha256. tools/install/checkparts.py compares a camera's dump (or the camera itself) with this list.
# Columns: kind, part, bytes, sha256, need, on_differ, note.
# file: a path in the unpacked dump (rootfs/ is the camera's /, miservice/ its /config, customer/ its /customer; nor.bin
#   the whole flash); byte-identical files under several names have a row each. region: a flash range of nor.bin,
#   NAME@offset. image: what lies inside a region from its start, NAME:what; KERNEL:Image is the kernel unpacked from the
# need: what of ours depends on the part (build, run, install, dump, restore), - = nothing.
# on_differ: stop = a difference stops the build and the install where need names them; warn = reported; info = reported
#   quietly, as a sign of another firmware build (left out under --quiet), never stops; data = the camera's own data,
#   different on every camera: not compared.
